title: 札幌記念の後に・Home Straight

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having finished the Sapporo Kinen, Fine Motion and Air Groove compliment each other's efforts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I receive a phone call from Fine Motion's older sister, who thanks me for getting Fine Motion to share her true feelings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the airport, we're met with a flood of fans who have caught wind of Fine Motion's plan to return home. She tells them she hopes they'll watch her final race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knowing that her next race could be her last ever, I narrow it down to four options.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While it's technically possible to enter all four races, the time for Fine Motion to decide which one she should run at the peak of her career draws near…
